sentences.text: Perusal of the record reveals that FIR No. 551/2020, PS Palam Vihar, Gurugram, Haryana, was registered on 13.12.2020, for the alleged commission of offence for causing death, not amounting to culpable homicide, by rash and negligent driving of a truck, bearing registration number HR55N-5649, on a public road, punishable under Section 279/304A of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereinafter referred as IPC).
Subsequently, charge sheet against respondent no. 1 was filed under section 279/304A/427 IPC and 56/192 A MV Act, before concerned Ld. Judicial Magistrate.

2. The brief facts of the case, as discernible from the claim petition and documents of the legal heirs/legal representatives of the deceased (hereinafter referred as LR's of the deceased/petitioners/claimants), are that, on 12.12.2020, at about 11.30 pm, the deceased namely Kuldeep Kumar, along with Ved Prakash Pandey was coming to his house on motor cycle bearing registration no. HR-55-AE-7547, (herein after referred as victim's vehicle) and when they reached near HP Petrol Pump Sector 23-A Gurugram Haryana, their motorcycle was hit by a Truck, bearing registration no. HR-55-N-5649 (herein MACT no. 33/21 Page 5 of43 Sita Devi vs. Dinesh Kumar &
Ors.
after referred as offending vehicle).

It was further averred that the offending vehicle was driven by its driver its driver Dinesh Kumar (herein after referred as driver cum owner-respondent no.1/R1),
in a rash and negligent manner and without caring for traffic rules.
It was averred that victim's vehicle was being driven by deceased Kuldeep Kumar Pandey at a normal speed and on the correct side of the road.

It was further averred that as a result of the said impact, Kuldeep Kumar Pandey sustained injuries, after which, he was taken to Civil Hospital, Gurugram, where he was declared as 'brought dead'.
3.

It was further stated that the postmortem on the body of the deceased Kuldeep Kumar Pandey was conducted at Mortuary Civil Hospital, Gurugram, vide PMR No. PKC/635/220, dated 13.12.2020, wherein cause of his death was mentioned as Head injury with shock and Hemorrhage following Ante Mortem Blunt force impact consistent with the manner as alleged.
